name: Create gym/setup profile
user_action: Choose gym, home gym, hotel gym, travel setup, or custom setup.
system_action: Load saved equipment profile or ask what equipment is available.
ai_role: Normalize equipment names and infer usable exercise pool; never invent unavailable equipment.

name: Start workout frame
user_action: Pick a saved template/program/day or start blank and manually add must-do exercises.
system_action: Create an editable ordered workout queue.
ai_role: Observe locked/manual exercises and unresolved gaps.

name: Set workout intent
user_action: Choose goal, target muscles/body region, time available, readiness, and optional style.
system_action: Apply hard constraints and retrieve eligible exercises.
ai_role: Use goal and context to score candidates.

name: AI fills missing workout
user_action: Tap AI Fill or ask for suggestions.
system_action: Keep locked items; fill only open slots or missing movement/muscle needs.
ai_role: Select from eligible database candidates; explain additions/substitutions.

name: Edit prescription
user_action: Adjust exercise order, sets, target reps, load target, RIR/RPE, tempo, notes, and rest time.
system_action: Save planned values separately from future performed values.
ai_role: Offer suggestions but preserve manual overrides.

name: Review workout
user_action: Confirm or keep editing. Repeated exercises and multiple exercises for one muscle are allowed.
system_action: Validate equipment, duplicate/family warnings, and session completeness.
ai_role: Flag likely redundancy without blocking intentional repeats.

name: Start session
system_action: Snapshot the plan into a live session and start elapsed session timer.
ai_role: Switch from planning mode to live-assistance mode.

name: Perform next set
user_action: Choose any queued exercise/set; enter actual reps, weight, RIR/RPE, or other tracking values.
system_action: Do not force fixed order; maintain a reorderable to-do queue.
ai_role: Surface prior performance and target values when useful.

name: Complete set + rest
system_action: Save performance immediately and start that set's configured rest timer automatically.
ai_role: No regeneration; optionally show next queued task.

name: Rest timer notification
user_action: Wait, skip rest, extend rest, or move to another exercise.
system_action: Notify/ping when timer expires; timer can be changed or dismissed.

name: Live edits
user_action: Reorder exercises, add/remove sets, substitute an exercise, skip an item, or add an unplanned exercise.
system_action: Record plan changes as session events while preserving original planned values.
ai_role: Suggest compatible substitutions from available equipment.

name: Finish workout
system_action: Store completed, skipped, partial, and added items; calculate summary.

name: Use history next time
user_action: Repeat workout, duplicate it, schedule it, or build from history.
system_action: Expose last weight/reps, best performance, adherence, and prior substitutions.
ai_role: Use history as context for future progression suggestions, subject to rules.
